property_summary: For any caller address A and ether amount v, when the contract's owner calls sendMoney to forward v to a callee, the original contract allows that owner call (not reverting) and thus the call can change address(c).balance accordingly; the mutant inverts onlyOwner so the genuine owner call will revert for some fuzzed inputs, breaking that universal property.
change_summary: Invert the onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, so only non-owners can call functions protected by the modifier.
